scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && py -3.11 startup_check.py && py -3.11 -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000 --log-level warning
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --names BACKEND,FRONTEND --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.install:backend: cd backend && py -3.11 -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend
